Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Other Terms & Conditions: - a) The offers shall be submitted through GeM Portal only. No other mode is acceptable. b) Bidder should necessarily mention the quoted make of the quoted items in the Bid docu ments.

c) As per GeM Provision, further extension of the offer submission due date is not allowed by the GeM Portal. Kindly submit offer on or before the due date to avoid any technical is sue. i. Inspection & Acceptance criteria: At NSL Central store, Visual Inspection of Material, Material test certificate, and verification of quantity at site shall be acceptance criteria. ii. Delivery Period: Within 30 days after receipt of original P.O. iii. Guarantee / Warranty: Applicable as per Gem GTC. iv. GST: Confirmation of percentage of GST on item wise basis. v. Payment Terms : Advance payment terms are not acceptable and is liable for rejection of the offer. Our standard payment terms are as below: “100% payment with applicable full taxes will be paid within 30 days of generation of G RN after receipt and acceptance of material at NSL Stores, Nagarnar.” vi. Penalty Clause: If the Seller fails to deliver any or all of the Goods within the original d elivery period (s) specified in the contract, the Buyer will reserve the right to levy/deduct /recover the penalty for the delay @ 0.5% of the basic order value of the un-delivered qu antity for each week or part thereof but subject to maximum 5% (five percent) of the tot al basic order value. vii. All terms and Conditions: All other terms & conditions would be applicable as per Ge m GTC and as per Gem bid documents.
